dialog: You're someone I might want to fight! Probably!
No hard feelings/ but this is a battle too.
If we're going to settle this by danmaku/ then try this!
When people fall back/ it can create a weak point!
If they get you/ you get them back...\n It's all a bit barbaric/ isn't it?
I can't miss this/ it's my best chance!
Stop to admire my storm of autumn leaves/ and you're going to get hurt!
Look at the falling leaves/ and let your heart be stilled.
It looks like you need some of the stillness of autumn.
All things are fated to wither and fall in their season...
The falling leaves dancing on the wind are my danmaku.
You too will fall/ like the autumn leaves...
Sometimes you've got to put in the extra effort/ right?
I'll show you the brilliance of autumn!
Shall we finish this up right here and now?
Well/ I suppose I'll have to use it.
With great spirit...
Fly free on the wind!
There's no way you can dodge this!
Dance on the wind...
Here I go...
Falling Blast!
At this distance it should make it...
Take this!
Falling Blast...
Come on/ hit them!
O autumn winds...
blow them away!
Minoriko/ let's do the usual!
Sure thing/ Shizuha!
Take this!
Super!
Aki Sisters!
KIIIIIICK!!!
...oh no/ I think we put too much into it!
Shizuha?\n Shizuha/ don't let go of my hand!
Shizuhaaaaaaaaa!
And with this...
you're through!
That did it!
When Minoriko and I are together/ we're unbeatable!
Shizuha/ let's use that one move!
Sure/ that's fine.
Super!
Aki Sisters!
KIIIIIICK!!!
... Ugh/ what is up with this air resistance?!
Shizuha?\n Shizuha/ don't let go of my hand!
Shizuhaaaaaaaaa!
And now...
How 'bout that?!
That did it!
Minoriko/ let's work together!
Sure/ Shizuha!
This is our special sisterhood technique...
Super!
Aki Sisters!
KIIIIIICK!!!
Is... is it me or is this not a lot tougher than during training?
No way! Just do it exactly like we did in training and―
Shizuhaaaaaaaaa!
This is the power...
of autumn!
And so stillness is restored...
The beauty of autumn is in its red leaves!
The beauty of autumn is in its bountiful harvests!
With these two autumns together...
Super!
Aki Sisters!
KIIIIIICK!!!
Is... is it me or is this not a lot tougher than during training?
No way! Just do it exactly like we did in training and―
Shizuhaaaaaaaaa!
Ready... Set...
Go!
And there's the finish!
The power of autumn will overcome!
With these beautiful red leaves!
Sweet Potato Batallion/ attack!
Autumn.. BUSTER!
The power of autumn will overcome!
With these beautiful red leaves!
Sweet Potato Batallion/ attack!
Harvest Festival!!!
We'll teach you the beauty of autumn!
With its withering leaves...
and its harvests!
Autumn Fever!
The beauty of autumn is in its bountiful harvests!
The beauty of autumn is in its red leaves!
By the power of our two autumns combined...
Super!
Aki Sisters!
KIIIIIICK!
GOLD!!!
... Ugh/ this is even more straining than before!
Wh- what are you saying?!\n Hold it together/ Shizuha!
Shizuhaaaaaaaaa!
Ready... Set...
GO!
And a spectacular finish!
With Shizuha and me together/ we've got this!
Shizuha/ let's use that one move!
Sure/ that's fine.
Super!
Aki Sisters!
KIIIIIICK!
Golden Autumn Special!
... Ugh/ what is up with this air resistance?!
Shizuha?\n Shizuha/ don't let go of my hand!
Shizuhaaaaaaaaa!
Eat...
this!
And a spectacular finish!
Shizuha/ let's work hand in glove!
Minoriko/ it's time for peak autumn power!
Okay/ Shizuha!
Super!
Aki Sisters!
KIIIIIICK!
Golden Maximum!
... Ugh/ my body feels like it's going to break!
Wh- what are you saying!\n We can't let this break us/ Shizuha!
Shizuhaaaaaaaaa!
Heave....
Ho!
And a spectacular finish!
I won't let myself be lured away too far.
Well/ I evaded it/ so... all's well that ends well I guess.
I can't attack like this...
No way/ they're outside of my reach!
I'll put your sacrifice to good use. You won't fall in vain.
I'll attack together with you!
I'm here too!
Helping out is one of my strong suits.
I'll make doubly sure they fall.
The enemy is here/ group up!
Good thing I was here...
I'll paint the target with my danmaku of fallen leaves!
Now that I've caught your attention!
Autumn winds/ lead the way!
I don't mind at all if you miss!
Let's do this carefully/ okay?
Each of us has our own part to play.
If I can at least interfere with their vision!
Helping out like this is one of my strong suits.
For the seasons to come after!
The falling leaves are the beauty of autumn!
I'll garland you with your demise!
A winter youkai did THAT for me?!
Gah/ I'm always so sleepy when I'm around you...
Autumn can still keep going!
I'll adorn this cold snap with my fallen leaves!
Letty/ Autumn isn't done for yet!
I know it fits your season/ but what are you doing lazing around?
I'll lay the groundwork for winter!
I can feel the advent of winter... it's close!
Ugh/ my leaves and my energy levels are both falling...
When there's not a hint of the autumn leaves left/ winter is coming...
Don't give me a fit of chills with the cold air/ Letty...
I don't need you to hold back on the cold air now!
Now I'll take over for winter!
I'll adorn this cold snap with my fallen leaves!
Your fallen blossoms will not go to waste!
For leaves to fall right after the flowers bloom feels a little rushed...
Lily/ let me help you out!
Even newly budded flowers will fall before you know it!
Lily/ you're weaker than I am.
Lily/ stop letting your attention wander!
Lily/ let's aim at that enemy!
It's a danmaku of beginnings and endings...
Lily/ let's do this/ okay?
Fighting alongside someone else isn't my specialty/ but here it goes.
Lily/ the autumn breeze will carry your flowers' petals!
Lily/ the autumn breeze will carry your flowers' petals!
For leaves to fall right after the flowers bloom feels a little rushed...
This is the danmaku of beginnings and endings!
I'll get revenge for Minoriko's death!
You're not fighting just Minoriko!
Minoriko/ may I help you out?
I'll add on even more of the power of autumn!
Minoriko/ watch out!
Minoriko/ don't get too fired-up!
With the two of us together/ it's the perfect autumn danmaku!
Now/ go for it/ Minoriko!
My autumn leaves are prettier though!
I'll add in my leaves!
Everything's ready for you/ Minoriko!
Minoriko/ are you bursting with the power of autumn too?
I'll add on even more of the power of autumn!
With the two of us together/ it's the perfect autumn danmaku!
I got away using my leafstreaming technique.
You won't catch hold of me like that.
When I go full out I can dodge like this!
If that's the best you can do against me/ I think you'd best surrender and turn over a new leaf.
That doesn't hurt that badly.\n Do you really deserve to call yourself my opponent?
Oh/ was this attack a practical joke?
You may have hit me/ but I'm fine!
What did you mean to do with that/ I wonder?
Someone/ please come help me out here!
I have a bad feeling about this...
The last leaf is about to fall...
What- what brute strength!
I... I can't take much more of this...
It ended up hitting me...
Egh! Were my movements that predictable?
This makes me kind of want to run away...
How outrageous...
I- I mustn't run away!
Minoriko and I are not gods of battle!
I have to hold out a little longer...
I can't lose my focus around this one.
That's a lot stronger than I thought it would be...
Hmph! Remember that I'm a god/ okay?!
Good/ everything's going so well.
If you watch closely/ you'll see it's this easy!
That kind of attack can't hit me!
Any faster and I might damage my clothes...
Your danmaku isn't getting through!
Phew/ just barely got through that I think.
This is supposed to be efficient/ I think?
You can't be too careful.
I got away using my leafstreaming technique.
I'm a little proud of how light on my feet I am.
Your attack would blow away in an autumn breeze!
Autumn Leaf Barrier!
This looks like my lucky break!
If you don't hurry up your attacks/ you'll be out of time!
You've got to shoot before you get shot!
I knew it/ I'm just not strong enough...
The last leaf falls...
I'm sorry/ every...one...
It's a little embarrassing for a god/\n but please forgive me/ everyone.
I can't fight anymore/\n so I'll be heading on back.
Miss Oni/\n you're so rowdy. I'll teach you the stillness of autumn.
I mean/ I don't EXPECT to beat her/ but...
How outrageous...
You're not fighting fair/ are you?
Well then/ I'll show you the power of autumn.
I'll bring an ending to this incident!
So- SO COLD!\n Aah/ now I'm all sleepy...
Aaah/ the feeling of slumbering with the leaves underneath the snow...
Even when you don't hit me it's still cold!
With my leafstreaming technique/ I won't fall into the clutches of winter.
Miss Swordswoman/ you'd best settle down. Imitate the stillness of autumn.
Collecting spring?\n You're involved in something dodgy/ there's no doubt.
You are worthy of being quieted with the stillness of autumn.
You're good at playing/ but we're in a hurry.
Miss Cat/ I'll teach you the stillness of autumn.
What absurd speed!
Miss Fox/ I'll teach you the stillness of autumn.
What absurd speed!
I'll be passing through.
Miss Swordswoman/ you'd best settle down. Imitate the stillness of autumn.
I'll be putting the seasons back to normal/\n so that autumn may come again!
I'll bring an ending to this incident!
But we were so close to fixing the seasons...
Is my power just not up to the task?
I'm a god of still-falling and just-fallen leaves―death would be a little premature/ don't you think?
Do you know of how lonely autumn nights can be?
I'll bring an ending to this battle/ right now.
Minoriko and I are not gods of battle!
What awesome power.\n You're almost comparable to a god yourself...
This power is comparable to a god's...
No matter what kind of big youkai you might be/ you can't catch hold of a rain of falling leaves!
Autumn leaves are a symbol of endings and demise... but let's ignore that for today.
Now let's liven things up with some pretty autumn foliage!
I'm going to fall before I get to beautify the festival!
Maybe I shouldn't have joined in just on a whim...
This sort of thing is going to be child's play!
It's fine to play around in a pile of danmaku fallen leaves.
Ow/ everyone these days plays for keeps...
Stop messing around with me by tearing off my leaves!
Utsuho/ it's too early for this to be your end!
We might differ a lot in power/ but let's see if I can smooth things over with a fellow god.
You just can't stay calm/ can you? It's best not to rush things.
Before you can disturb the others/
You've gone too far.
You just can't see the view from here/ can you?
Oh/ I wonder where my duplicate could be?
I can't believe you've had to stoop to this.
This really isn't good...
This is wild... a youkai filling herself with another youkai's power...
You already have nothing left to spare...
You're causing grief to the humans.\n I'll be putting a quick end to this.
The end to all your ambitions draws ever nearer.
You're causing grief to the humans.\n I'll be putting a quick end to this.
The end to all your ambitions draws ever nearer.
